title: Deterministic Stateless Beyond-Birthday-Bound MAC
summary: A deterministic, stateless beyond-birthday-bound MAC remains to be constructed and is the main obstacle to authenticated encryption tolerating arbitrary nonce repetition.

formal_statement.body: Construct a deterministic, stateless message-authentication code (MAC) that achieves beyond-birthday-bound (BBB) security. Constructing such a MAC is known to be notably difficult and is the main obstacle to constructing an authenticated-encryption scheme that remains BBB-secure even when nonces are repeated arbitrarily.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, specifically message authentication and authenticated encryption.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a deterministic, stateless MAC that achieves beyond-birthday-bound security.

citations.label: Counter-in-Tweak: Authenticated Encryption Modes for Tweakable Block Ciphers

progress.summary: The source presents authenticated encryption that remains beyond-birthday-bound secure under arbitrary nonce repetition as an open problem and identifies the required MAC as its notably hard main obstacle.
